lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of circular high-luminance blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. The first column contains five nodes, the second contains four nodes, and the third contains four nodes, forming a rectilinear grid-like arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting with the circular high-luminance blobs, particularly evident in the second and third columns posterior to the gills, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal side and a high-contrast shadow region on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, irregularly shaped high-luminance clusters, significantly affected by optical interference from overhead caustic light patterns.
